# AI Pro Freelancer

> Price-checked buying guides for freelancers and small teams: VPS hosting, AI voice tools, SEO tools, funnel builders, trading charts and VPNs. Each guide quotes prices from the vendor's official pricing page with the date it was checked, shows the real total over 12/24/36 months including renewal prices, and ends with a situation-based recommendation. We do not claim lab tests we have not run. Affiliate links are disclosed on every page.

## Methodology

- [How we check prices](https://aiprofreelancer.com/how-we-check-prices/): Sources, check dates and how renewal totals are calculated.
- [VPS Price Index 2026](https://aiprofreelancer.com/vps-price-index-2026/): Intro vs renewal monthly prices for popular VPS plans, updated regularly.
